event: Nala wakes from sleep, curled tight in the warm dark of the womb.
prose: Nala woke all at once, with no dream to drift up through. She was asleep, and then she wasn't, curled tight in the warm dark with her knees drawn up to her chest.

event: She tries to sit up; the small body only shifts, folded too tight to rise.
prose: She went to sit up, to get her bearings the way she would have in a strange bedroom. The small body only shifted. It was folded too tight to rise, and the effort came to a slow roll of her shoulders and a twitch in one leg.

event: This body can shift, stretch a little and kick, and nothing more; sitting up is beyond it.
She has no eyes to look with, and her soul-sense stops at her own skin.
So she takes stock by touch: warm fluid all round her, a soft wall close on every side.
The cord lies against her belly, soft and tethering.
A heartbeat thumps through everything, steady and slow: her mother's.
The cold, dark threads of the demon still run through her soul, woven in among it.
She calls up her Status, and the words open in her mind, plain as print.
Status: Name: none. Class: Locked. Skills: none, 3 empty slots.
Body Features: Aether Core: Minor. Aether Channels: Weak.
Attributes: Strength 100, Stamina 100, Coordination 100, Mental 104, Aether 100.
Paths: Basic Numeracy (Tier 4), Exceptionalism (Tier 1), Soulstealing (0 steps).
Achievements: Defeat a Lesser Demon Prince while unborn; Consume another soul.
Beyond the wall, voices start up close beside her mother, several of them.
The words come blurred through flesh and fluid, too muffled to make out.
The voices talk on beside her mother, low and steady, and Nala lies listening.
